taskInfo.name: Personalized Email Automation for Job Applicants
taskInfo.description: Automate sending personalized emails to job applicants and maintain a record of their data and status in an Excel sheet without using an Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
taskInfo.goal: Create a system to send personalized emails to job applicants and track their status using a spreadsheet.
taskInfo.summary: This task involves creating a system to automate sending personalized emails to job applicants and tracking their status in an Excel sheet without using an ATS.  The system will use a loop of Thought, Action, PAUSE, Observation to achieve this goal.
